name: Rideout Customs
short_description: A Vice City vehicle modification shop, exclusive to Ultimate Edition owners, offering custom rims, interiors and donk-style builds.
long_description: Rideout Customs is a vehicle customization shop confirmed as part of the Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition content. Rockstar Games describes the shop as offering detailed interiors, custom rims and "donk stylings" that are only available to players who purchase the Ultimate Edition. Promotional imagery shows rims with Ace of Spades-shaped cutouts, glitter paintwork and a red speckled interior applied to a customized vehicle. The shop is one of several Ultimate Edition exclusive storefronts confirmed by Rockstar ahead of pre-orders opening on 25 June 2026, alongside One-Eyed Willie's, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305 and Electric Fang Tattoo. Standard Edition owners cannot access Rideout Customs unless they purchase the Ultimate Edition upgrade.

name: One-Eyed Willie's
short_description: An off-road vehicle mod shop in Lake Leonida, exclusive to Ultimate Edition owners, specializing in hand-painted custom art.
long_description: One-Eyed Willie's is an off-road vehicle modification shop located in Lake Leonida, confirmed as Ultimate Edition exclusive content for Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games describes it as specializing in modifications and hand-painted custom art for off-road vehicles, distinguishing it from the street and lowrider focus of Rideout Customs, the game's other confirmed mod shop. It was revealed alongside the rest of the Ultimate Edition bonus content ahead of pre-orders opening on 25 June 2026. The name is widely believed by fans to reference the pirate character One-Eyed Willy from the 1985 film The Goonies, though Rockstar has not confirmed this connection. The shop is not accessible to Standard Edition owners.

name: Only Raw Records
short_description: A hip-hop record label and recording studio in Vice City, co-founded by characters Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike.
long_description: Only Raw Records is a fictional hip-hop record label and recording studio confirmed for Grand Theft Auto VI, co-founded by characters Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike. Rockstar Games' official character material describes Dre'Quan as running the creative side of the label while Boobie, owner of the Jack of Hearts strip club, provides its funding. The label's first signing is the rap duo Real Dimez, made up of performers Bae-Luxe and Roxy. The label was first reported publicly in May 2025 press coverage tied to a Rockstar trailer and release-date update, and has since been corroborated by Rockstar's official character bios for Dre'Quan Priest and Boobie Ike on rockstargames.com.
